notes.title: Major update with new features!
notes.notes:
Time Bandit Part 1 just received a major update with new features. A summary of the biggest changes follows, with more details below.

To celebrate the big update, as well as everyone's favorite time-related holiday, the end of Daylight Savings Time, Time Bandit Part 1 will be on sale for 20% off!


Buy furniture for your home from the shop
Steam achievements
Steam Cloud functionality and save backups
Added the moon and accurate moon phases
Added seasons for the forest
Added a few new radio conversations
Button prompts to advance dialogue will now be updated to your remapped controls


Buy furniture for your home
https://i.imgur.com/1Vz10AY.jpg
Joseph now sells furniture for your home at the gas station. It's not much, but it's better than nothing!

Steam achievements
https://i.imgur.com/Hsk1pKY.png
There are now 11 Steam achievements to collect, from getting radicalized to collecting all the secret time crystals and stealing the maximum possible time crystals in Part 1. If you've already been playing Time Bandit, you will have to start a new game to collect many of the achievements.

Steam Cloud functionality and save backups
Now you can save your game to the Cloud. If you've already finished Part 1, I recommend loading up the game just to send a backup to the cloud, in case you switch hardware before Part 2 comes out.

I've heard reports for other games of Steam Cloud overwriting saves when switching between devices (e.g., between a PC and a Steam Deck), so I also set up local save backups. Hopefully you won't have to use them, but in case anything goes wrong, see the FAQ for how to restore your save from a backup.

Added the moon and accurate moon phases
https://i.imgur.com/X0FBi8g.png
Now there are real-time moon phases that are (approximately) accurate to the day. While setting these up, I also noticed and fixed an issue with transitioning out of sunrises, which most people probably never ran into since I doubt many are playing the game at sunrise.

Added seasons for the forest
Return to the forest year-round to see how your trees are growing and changing. It's a lovely autumn right now.

Updated button prompts for advancing dialogue
If you remapped the action button, the button prompt for advancing dialogue will now update properly to your remapped control. Due to display limits, if you use a button that is represented by more than one or two characters, it may be difficult to read (e.g., for spacebar, which may be a common button to remap to, the word "space" may be too tiny to read).

Minor changes to [spoiler]glitch bomb[/spoiler] item
[spoiler]When you pick up the glitch bomb in the world or buy it from the shop, you will now receive 3 glitch bombs. The price was too expensive for just one.[/spoiler]

Incidentally, just as I was preparing to publish this update, Valve reviewed Time Bandit Part 1 for Steam Deck compatibility, and it received playable status. This is in line with what I expected from players who said that the game was working well for them on the Deck. The main limitation is that you need to bring up the keyboard to enter information into a couple of textboxes at the start of the game, which you can do simply by pressing the steam button + X. Otherwise, it's a great way to play an idle adventure game like this!

In addition, I quietly made numerous bugfix updates in the weeks following the launch (we were up to v1.0.13 before this v1.1.0 update!). I may add an official changelog in the Steam forums when I get the chance, just in case anyone is curious about what exactly was fixed!

If you haven't checked out Time Bandit Part 1, get it while it's 20% off, and be sure to try out the new furniture for your home!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1481910/Time_Bandit/

notes.title: Big update to the free Time Bandit prologue chapter
notes.notes:
As part of the Games from Québec Steam sale, the free prologue chapter for Time Bandit received a big update!

Check out new art, music, real-time weather tied to your location, and more for a limited time.

There's a new high score ranking too. How many time crystals can you collect before you reach the end of the demo?

You can download the demo now from the Time Bandit store page.
